_comment: Declarative policy for hooks/policy-gate.sh (head and sons). cmd = command word(s) after wrappers, runners and shell -c are unwrapped; sub = positional words that must appear in order; flags = exact flags (--flag=value also matches); short_flags = single letters that may be bundled (-fu); abbrev = long flags may be shortened to 5+ characters; plus_refspec = a push refspec starting with +; bare_cmd = the command with no operand dumps data.
